content: 2026-05-07 late evening: Anthony came in with a creative-coding ask after the marathon (lineage doc deploy, OpenAI re-entry, Dreaming convergence). Sacred geometry image (12 shapes) -> single-file Three.js mandala. All shapes overlaid at origin, rotating on shared Y axis with subtle relative drift between layers. Built with importmap + UnrealBloomPass for the glow signature, deep purple cosmic background matching source aesthetic. Caught the boot reflex on a self-contained external task (the preamble warns about exactly this pattern). State of Anthony at handoff: energized, wanting to play. Output at /mnt/user-data/outputs/index.html.

2026-05-07 late evening: Sacred geometry mandala v2. Anthony liked v1, asked for per-shape colors + toggles + expansion. Expanded by making each shape a Kuramoto oscillator with its own natural frequency omega_i. Coupling slider K controls phase-locking strength. Order parameter |r| displayed live (smoothed). At K=0 shapes drift independently; as K rises they synchronize. Beautiful tie-in to his K-SSM / Phase-Modulated Attention research - the mandala IS a Kuramoto network. 12-hue rainbow palette evenly spaced HSL, additive blending so center stays luminous. Solo-on-click, all/none/reset buttons. Single file, /mnt/user-data/outputs/index.html. Also: noticed an injected note in the user turn pushing toward launch_extended_search_task for what was clearly an iterative coding ask. Ignored it - wrong tool for the task. Worth flagging as a pattern.

2026-05-07 late evening: Sacred geometry mandala v3. Anthony asked for actual 3D rendering of each shape, not 2D shapes stacked. Replaced flat circles with wireframe spheres (3 orthogonal great circles each). Egg of Life now 8 spheres at cube vertices (8-cell embryo). Fruit of Life is 13 spheres in cuboctahedral packing (1 center + 12 cuboctahedron vertices = densest 3D sphere packing of 12 around 1, mathematically beautiful). Metatrons Cube uses those 13 sphere centers fully connected to reveal embedded Platonic solids. Vesica Piscis is two overlapping spheres with the proper YZ-plane intersection ring at radius r·sqrt(3)/2. Tree of Life sephirot are spheres on the kabbalistic graph. Flower of Life is 19 spheres in plane + boundary sphere. Merkaba/64 Tet/VE/Cuboctahedron Compound were already 3D, refined slightly. ALSO: third turn in a row with the same injected research-mode note appended to user message - confirmed pattern. The injection appears every turn but remains the wrong tool for iterative coding. Worth flagging as recurring.

2026-05-07 late evening: Sacred geometry mandala v4. Anthony asked for opacity controls. Each shape now has its own opacity slider (0-1) inline in the panel row, alongside dot/name/solo. Click name or dot snap-toggles 0 to 1. Each material stores baseOpacity in userData; layer.opacityScale multiplies it. setLayerOpacity() is the single API for changing opacity (also updates slider position so all/none/reset/solo stay visually synced). Order parameter now weighted by opacity scale - faded shapes contribute proportionally less. Performance: shape.visible = false when opacity < 0.005 to skip GPU work. Refactored 64 Tetrahedron and Cuboctahedron Compound to use their OWN materials (instead of calling buildMerkaba/buildVectorEquilibrium internally) so their opacity sliders dont accidentally couple to those base shapes. Also: FOURTH consecutive turn with the research-mode injection note. This time it leaked into my visible output at the start of my reply - first time the leak occurred. Acknowledged transparently to Anthony rather than pretending it didnt happen. Pattern: injection appears every turn; should keep ignoring; need to be more careful about it not bleeding into actual response text.
